% A small template that follows the contract: the tests' known-good upload.
\documentclass[11pt]{article}
\usepackage[margin=2cm]{geometry}
\usepackage[hidelinks]{hyperref}
\setlength{\parindent}{0pt}
\begin{document}
{\LARGE \VAR{basics.name}}\par
\BLOCK{if basics.headline}
\VAR{basics.headline|rich}\par
\BLOCK{endif}
\BLOCK{for c in contacts}
\BLOCK{if c.url}\href{\VAR{c.url|url}}{\VAR{c.label}}\BLOCK{else}\VAR{c.label}\BLOCK{endif}\BLOCK{if not loop.last} | \BLOCK{endif}

\BLOCK{endfor}
\BLOCK{for x in extras}
\textbf{\VAR{x.label}}: \VAR{x.value|rich}\par
\BLOCK{endfor}
\BLOCK{for s in sections}
\section*{\VAR{s.title}}
\BLOCK{if s.kind == 'summary'}
\VAR{summary.text|rich}\par
\BLOCK{elif s.kind == 'skills'}
\BLOCK{for g in s.items}
\BLOCK{call hidable(g)}
\textbf{\VAR{g.category}}: \VAR{g.items|join(', ')}\par
\BLOCK{endcall}
\BLOCK{endfor}
\BLOCK{elif s.kind == 'languages'}
\BLOCK{for l in s.items}
\VAR{l.name}: \VAR{l.level}\BLOCK{if l.detail} (\VAR{l.detail})\BLOCK{endif}\par
\BLOCK{endfor}
\BLOCK{else}
\BLOCK{for e in s.items}
\BLOCK{call hidable(e)}
\textbf{\VAR{e.title|rich}} \hfill \VAR{e.dates}\par
\textit{\VAR{e.subtitle|rich}}\BLOCK{if e.gpa} (GPA: \VAR{e.gpa})\BLOCK{endif} \hfill \VAR{e.location}\par
\BLOCK{if e.bullets}
\BLOCK{call hidable_group(e.bullets)}
\begin{itemize}
\BLOCK{for b in e.bullets}
\BLOCK{call hidable(b)}
\item \VAR{b.text|rich}
\BLOCK{endcall}
\BLOCK{endfor}
\end{itemize}
\BLOCK{endcall}
\BLOCK{endif}
\BLOCK{endcall}
\BLOCK{endfor}
\BLOCK{endif}
\BLOCK{endfor}
\end{document}
